# Stadium

<!-- Generated from manifest.json by scripts/build.js. Do not edit by hand. -->

Uruguayan footwear, clothing and accessories retailer with branches across the country. Sells sneakers, sandals, boots, clothing and accessories such as bags and backpacks for men, women and children, from brands including Adidas, Nike, Puma and New Balance. Ships to all of Uruguay through UES, DAC, Correo and PedidosYa.

*ES:* Cadena uruguaya de calzado, ropa y accesorios con sucursales en el país. Vende championes, sandalias, botas, ropa y accesorios como bolsos y mochilas para hombre, mujer y niños, de marcas como Adidas, Nike, Puma y New Balance. Envía a todo Uruguay por UES, DAC, Correo y PedidosYa.
